name: 作業範囲と進捗の面グラフ
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. LH09-0057 task scope/progress area chart component.
ORIGINAL image2 crop primary edit base, image1 full context; originals PRIMARY for exact plot geometry, slope/proportions, date values, stroke/optical weight, spacing and detail. Mock image3 SECONDARY Japanese copy; its same-color two green areas flatten the distinct source series.
White compact chart surface/canvas, no added enclosing card. Upper-left title「進捗」with original tiny downward triangle, Meiryo Regular14/24, neutral ink/slate.
Exactly TWO straight rising area series from SAME lower-left baseline point to SAME right-edge x: upper original MAGENTA/pink scope line reaches original high point; lower progress line reaches exactly original lower height (about two-thirds of upper rise), adapted forest green #1F6444. Match original source triangle geometry and all endpoints, no extra bend, grid, tick, label, number or legend. Thin lines; translucent area fills fade smoothly to WHITE toward shared baseline, distinguish upper pink-only band and lower green progress area, no broad mint page fill.
Only bottom date labels「3月30日」left,「4月6日」right, Meiryo Regular12/16 tracking0 gray. No axes values, no invented metrics. Preserve original margins, quiet hierarchy, no bold heading, heavy borders, shadows or extra controls. Pure-white outer background; restrained plot fills are data series, not page tint.
reviewNotes: Distinct magenta scope/forest-green progress restored and Japanese dates/header checked. Lower endpoint proportion appears higher than source (about70% vs source roughly66.5% of upper rise); targeted slope correction pending.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
